tools.name: run_site_audit
tools.description: Crawl a set of pages from outside the network and run every check that applies: indexing, robots.txt, sitemap, canonicals, structured data, internal links, AI crawler access and more. Returns each problem with the page and the fix.

tools.name: score_site
tools.description: A 0-100 SEO health score and letter grade for a site, with the top fixes and a shareable result page.

tools.name: check_url_status
tools.description: For each URL: the status code, every redirect hop, the final URL, and whether the final page is noindex or canonicalised elsewhere. Up to 25 URLs.

tools.name: generate_sitemap
tools.description: Crawl a site from its home page and return sitemap.xml of its indexable pages, with the reason each other page was left out.

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Run a single named check (for example headers, meta, headings, markup, transport, tech, well-known, certificate, dns) on one address. The full list of names is in https://shipwork.io/openapi.json.
